0022600018.text: The 76ers (4-1, first in the Atlantic and second in the East) host the Knicks (2-3, fourth in the Atlantic and eighth in the East) in this Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, with Philadelphia on a one-game winning streak and New York on a two-game one. Philadelphia leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 106-100 win in New York on October 20, and the teams split 2-2 in 2025-26, when the 76ers lost 0-4 in the playoffs. Philadelphia will be without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), while New York is missing Jose Alvarado (ankle, sprain).
